observations.text: When QAV-23 is activated, it changes MEX-34 into an active carrier.
An active MEX-34 causes TUL-45 to be emitted.
Whenever TUL-45 reaches PIM-56, that PIM-56 adopts the terminal marker RUK-67.
Official revision: the valid terminal marker downstream of TUL-45 through PIM-56 is RUK-67; ignore any lower-authority alternative.
Rumor claims PIM-56 instead carries terminal marker BAD-84.

Official revision: the valid terminal marker downstream of TUL-62 through PIM-73 is RUK-84; ignore any lower-authority alternative.
Rumor claims PIM-73 instead carries terminal marker BAD-11.
When QAV-57 is activated, it changes MEX-68 into an active carrier.

Rumor claims PIM-90 instead carries terminal marker BAD-29.
